label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee for the mayor in the great hall at day 1, 18:00: replacing spoiled bread with 200 fresh loaves, installing eight lanterns, and bringing the mayor under the pretext of a lighting inspection. Baker knowingly supplied 44 loaves on credit. Secretary handled the inspection appointment and learned partial details, but is not clearly a knowing collaborator; secretary told mayor about private bread, jubilee payment and confidentiality request, without establishing its exact purpose. Thus mayor received hints, but was not told the full surprise plan.
